//xAccounts: X handles WITHOUT the @. Replace with the real market-movers you want (elonmusk, realDonaldTrump, blknoiz06, MustStopMurad, etc.). Keep total to 20-40.
//axiomPattern: Axiom has NO documented deeplink API. This is the community-guessed pattern and may be wrong - verify one alert's Axiom link, then fix here. The mint is always shown in the alert so you can paste it into Axiom search regardless.
//filters: What counts as a signal worth alerting on inside a tweet.
//dedupeMinutes: Ignore the same detected token from the same source within this many minutes.
//stream: Real-time websocket feed from Helius (logsSubscribe). Buys reach you in ~1-2s instead of the 20s poll. Free on the standard key. The poll stays on as backfill. Set false to use polling only.
//enrich: Attach a rug-safety grade (RugCheck) + live price/liquidity/age (Dexscreener) to every token alert. Both free. Set false to disable.
//convergence: Fire a louder CONVERGENCE alert when this many DISTINCT watched wallets buy the same mint within windowMinutes. This is the highest-signal event in a tracked set.
